Camera Configuration JSON

Configure Object contains at least id, name, selected, profileType, captureMode`and `structuredLightParams, swingLineScanParams, passiveBinocularParams, videoStreamParams , the grouping associated with the current model.captureMode: 0 Video stream,1 Structure light,2 Passive binary,3 Swinging the wires,4 Fixed-line sweep.

Public Configuration Fields: Depth/Colour Source 2D Exposure time (%1)ms) & Gains ( )dBExposure mode ( )0 Manual/1 Auto.paramsBatch3D Multiple exposure parameters,textureSource(0 None/1 Depth Source/2 Colour source, light patch,2D/3D Resolution mode, smoothing and filtering level. Structured optical fields also include exposed partitions, projecting mode, project brightness, hole filling and 3D ROI;wirescanning fields contain Z Scopemm, the angle (degrees), cloud density, laser brightness; the video stream field contains a three-road map source switch.

Parameter Styles JSON Press common, structuredLight, swingLineScan, passiveBinocular, videoStream grouping;per argument description contains displayText, dataType, bounds, step, default, priority, componentType.

LineScanStatus

This count corresponds to the stage string returned by the camera end:

Enumeration values Description

Idle

The service is idle, has not yet begun to clear the line and has not yet produced a recent result.

Starting

Checking configuration and starting scanning device.

WaitingForConnection

Device activated, waiting SDK Create line sweeps WebSocket.

Streaming

WebSocket Connected, data are being collected and transmitted.

Finalizing

Received EOT, is in the process of collating the data for this line sweep.

Saving

Combining strips and generating and publishing EpicRaw.

Completed

Wire sweeps EpicRaw The processing was successfully completed.

Stopping

Responding to the request for a voluntary cessation.

Stopped

It has been stopped on its own initiative and has not been accomplished naturally.

Failed

Failed at start-up, transmission, closing or storage.

Unknown

SDK A status name for the current version was received.

stopLineScan It’s…​ statusHex The hexadecimal string that is associated with the service end state code.
